note: PROGRAM config. This is NOT an ExperimentConfig - it binds the baseline and lists the variants. Each variant's own config.json under <slug>/ is the hashed ExperimentConfig.
blocked_on: the StrategyConfig seam in v2/analysis does not exist yet; strategy_inputs below specify what it must expose

research_population.population: all resolved outcomes incl. slot-suppressed shadows
research_population.note: 3x the admitted population and free of admission selection; resolves 0.031 R where the admitted set resolves 0.053 R

must_not_change: data_snapshot_id / the corpus (a rebuild is a different dataset, C-6.10)
OutcomeConfig and its hash (segments the dataset, C-4.12)
requirements.txt (C-19 determinism contract; editing it is a re-baselining event)
the replay engine, audit system, capture schema and bundle format
max_open_positions = 10 (the cap binds 51% of cycles and is doing useful selection)
must_reverify_per_variant: backtest.cli identity --run <baseline> -> 0 mismatches over 886954 ledger rows

variants.role: harness validation - must reproduce metrics_hash exactly
noise removal + target cap, entry universe preserved
upper bound on any directional rule; never promoted from tier 0
falsification arm - predicted to prune, not add edge

scoring_v2.supersedes: the scoring portion of r1-core-cleanup (variant_id 67c01d47aa327358), whose strategy_inputs assumed all eight zero-information components were bit-neutral to remove. Phase A / A1 showed only the five never-fires components are; the three always-fires components are constants and are now KEPT. r1's target.rr_cap is superseded by B1.

secondary_reported_may_veto: trade frequency and resulting slot concurrency
slot utilisation (baseline 51% of cycles at cap)
alert precision by tier (A+/VALID currently p_adj 0.89 - no information)
signal distribution by direction / session / year / regime / symbol
volume-matched control delta (mandatory for r2, r3, r3b, r3q)
success_criteria.pruning_rule: a variant whose expectancy rises while total R falls is classified as PRUNING, not edge, and is excluded from replay bundles

statistics.forbidden_screening: shortened replay windows - a one-year replay resolves only ~0.10 R
statistics.correction: Holm-Bonferroni within each comparison family; report adjusted p

holdout.status: DECLARED AS A RULE - snapshot not yet acquired

rule.snapshot: to be built at final evaluation time; a forward window is not in any existing snapshot
rule.snapshot_binding: holdout.py binds a lock to a data_snapshot_id, so the formal `holdout declare` runs at acquisition. This committed rule plus its commit timestamp is the ordering proof.
look_allocation: one corrected implementation if the first look revealed a bug
rule.acquire_last: the forward window grows ~730 cycles/month, so acquiring at programme end yields a larger holdout than acquiring now. Declaration must precede variant runs; acquisition must not.

rejection_rules: the sign of the variant's primary factor disagrees with TRAIN
max drawdown per trade more than 50% worse than TRAIN
holdout.comparator: variant vs control WITHIN the holdout run, not against the frozen baseline. A forward snapshot has a different data_snapshot_id, so ComparisonKey correctly refuses a diff against c8542cb360d13207; a paired in-run control is the valid comparison and also permits a deeper universe for power.

is_a_gate_not_a_confirmation.reason: sigma(realized_r) = 1.667 R. 80% power for an effect delta needs n = 21.79/delta^2, so +0.040 R needs 13,617 trades and +0.030 R needs 24,208. No window in this corpus can confirm the predicted effects; a small holdout can still refute a large claim.
is_a_gate_not_a_confirmation.consequence: pre-declare REJECTION thresholds, never promotion ones, and report every holdout result with its own minimum detectable effect

void_prior_lock.status: VOID for this corpus - a holdout binds to a dataset, not a period (holdout.py, C-6.10). Left in place deliberately; not reused, not deleted.

why_rejected: load-bearing in variant selection: the per-year consistency screen that justifies R1-R3 counted 2026 as one of its four years
the most favourable period in the corpus - the unmodified baseline already earns +0.0587 R there, so any variant inherits a tailwind
5-7x too small for the predicted effects
no embargo against max_holding_h1 = 168 leaking December 2025 entries into January 2026 outcomes

partition.note: Evaluation-time roles. No replay is sharded; one unsharded run is sliced.

DEV.why_no_authority: every Phase 3 study read this period; it is contaminated by prior research and is kept as a labelled diagnostic, not as validation

promotion_test.test: one-sided binomial sign test over TRAIN quarters
promotion_test.derived_thresholds: smallest k with p <= 0.05; at 10 slices that is 9 (p=0.0107) with 8 as the flag (p=0.0547)
promotion_test.superseded: the earlier 'positive in 4/4 years' screen could never reach alpha=0.05 - its smallest attainable p is 0.0625
promotion_test.deciding_comparator: per-quarter delta vs the VOLUME-MATCHED CONTROL. The absolute test (is the book profitable each quarter) is weak because the baseline loses money in most quarters; the vs-baseline test is passed trivially by any rule that drops the worst trades.
